choice: buildValhallaRequest must return exactly the documented body, with no extra keys: locations [{lat, lon}] x2, costing auto, units kilometers, directions_type none, plus exclude_locations [{lat, lon, radius: Math.round(avoidRadiusM)}] only when avoid is non-empty. A response missing trip, trip.legs or trip.summary is malformed and gives UpstreamError. A 400 with any error_code other than 442/171 (for example 154, distance limit), or a 400 that is not JSON, gives UpstreamError('valhalla'), not NoRouteError, InputError or TripTooLongError.
options: Allow extra keys in the request body (for example costing_options)
